content: Ligand 2 is the pool leader and I have already elaborated it; ligand 1 is the dimethoxybenzyl urea again, which is a convenient blank host - zero activity, but the best SA in the pool. Every NH-azine link I have installed so far has been a pyrimidine or a quinazoline, i.e. all azines of the same family, so I do not yet know whether the model is reading pyrimidine specifically or electron-poor N-heteroaryl-NH-aryl more generally. The cleanest way to separate those is a different heterocycle class entirely, so I am installing benzothiazol-2-ylamino: a 1,3-thiazole-fused azine, and the actual recognition element of AS601245, a bona fide JNK inhibitor. Step 1: the primary acetamide at atoms 15-18 is the throwaway piece (2 donors, TPSA 102.7, no benefit). Atom 14 is the aromatic carbon bearing it, the 14-15 bond is non-ring, so cut there and attach the N-linked 2-aminobenzothiazole.
